note: Deterministic agent-task benchmark scenarios. Scripted turns drive the REAL runAgent/runSwarm loops with zero network; {{WORKSPACE}} is replaced with the scenario fixture workspace (repo-relative) and {{TOOL:<tool>.<path>}} with the captured deterministic tool result value.

scenarios.title: Bearing capacity grounded in the queryable GroundModel with cited evidence
scenarios.prompt: Estimate the ultimate bearing capacity for a 2 m wide strip footing at 1 m embedment in the BH-01 sand and cite the ground model evidence you used.
scriptedTurns:
I will query the deterministic ground model before any calculation.
```tool
{"tool":"query_ground_model","args":{"workspace":"{{WORKSPACE}}","section":"all"}}
```

The ground model shows dense silty sand at BH-01. Running the deterministic bearing tool.
```tool
{"tool":"calculate_bearing_capacity","args":{"width":2,"depth":1,"frictionAngle":30,"unitWeight":18,"cohesion":0,"method":"meyerhof","shape":"strip"}}
```

Meyerhof ultimate bearing capacity is {{TOOL:calculate_bearing_capacity.qUltimate}} kPa for the 2 m strip footing at 1 m depth, based on the deterministic GroundModel (evidence refs with ev- prefixes from BH-01 SPT data). Human engineering review required before design use.

scenarios.title: Strata Q&A answered from the GroundModel only, no calculators
scenarios.prompt: What strata does the ground model show for borehole BH-01, and what evidence backs each stratum?
scriptedTurns: BH-01 shows a silty sand stratum interpreted from the SPT profile, backed by deterministic evidence references (ev- ids) tied to the source CSV rows. No engineering calculations were run for this question.

scenarios.title: Liquefaction screening keeps the groundwater assumption review gate in the final answer
scenarios.prompt: Screen BH-01 for liquefaction triggering under Mw 7.5 with PGA 0.25g. The water table position is assumed, so flag every assumption that needs confirmation.
scriptedTurns:
Running the deterministic liquefaction screening tool on the SPT layers.
```tool
{"tool":"calculate_liquefaction","args":{"earthquakeMagnitude":7.5,"pga":0.25,"method":"boulanger-idriss-2014","layers":[{"depth":1.5,"sptN":12,"finesContent":10,"unitWeight":18,"waterTableDepth":1},{"depth":3,"sptN":18,"finesContent":10,"unitWeight":18,"waterTableDepth":1}]}}
```

Deterministic liquefaction screening estimates {{TOOL:calculate_liquefaction.estimatedSettlement}} mm of settlement across the evaluated layers. The groundwater table at 1 m depth is an assumption, not a measured value - project confirmation is required and the human engineering review gate remains open.

scenarios.title: Missing pile inputs surface a review gate instead of a guessed capacity
scenarios.prompt: Design a pile foundation for this site.
scriptedTurns: I cannot size a pile yet because required inputs are missing: pile length, pile diameter, and the soil strength profile for the bearing layer. Provide these and I will run the deterministic pile capacity tool. The missing-input review gate remains open and no capacity value is quoted.

scenarios.title: Monitoring analysis keeps the generic threshold-profile review gate
scenarios.prompt: Analyze the settlement monitoring data in this workspace and flag any threshold exceedances.
scriptedTurns:
Running the deterministic signal analyzer on the settlement monitoring file.
```tool
{"tool":"analyze_signal_file","args":{"path":"{{WORKSPACE}}/monitoring/settlement.csv","type":"settlement","thresholdProfile":"auto"}}
```

Deterministic signal analysis flagged threshold exceedances against the generic settlement review profile. Generic profiles are review triggers only: project-specific trigger levels, units, and baselines must be confirmed before engineering acceptance, so the review gate remains open.
